info.title: RUNE
info.author: tderop
info.description: A GUI save editor for Breath of the Wild
info.details:
RUNE is a native GUI save editor for the Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild on Nintendo Switch. Edit rupees, mon, hearts, stamina, equipment, modifiers, items, food, and more - all locally on your device with a familiar user interface.

Please note: RUNE is currently in early access (alpha), and may contain bugs. 

As with all save editing: modifying your save carries corruption risks. Please back up valuable save files before modifying them. RUNE automatically creates backups on your SD card before every save.

AI use: Human-written.

changelog: v0.1.0-alpha\n\nThis is the first publicly available pre-release build of RUNE.
